content:
marisol: Postmortem follow-up: recurring token-count drift observed across three incidents in the last quarter. We need: concrete owners, timelines, and a recurrence prevention plan.

eli: Can someone summarize the pattern? My read is delayed batch ordering + occasional duplicate delta from the aggregator.

kevin: Yep. Root cause in the last outage was a race between batch-ack and aggregator checkpointing when the ingestion leader changed. That created transient double-counts for ~30m windows.

lina: Impacted invoices: Mar 11-12 window (primary), plus two smaller blips Feb 04 and Jan 19. I ran a quick aggregation and saw a 1.8%-2.7% upwards bias on those windows.

samir: I've instrumented a histogram for per-account token delta and added a drift metric: sum(billed) - sum(emitted) / sum(emitted). Will alert if >0.5% for 1h.

maggie: From CS ops: affected customers are flagged in the CRM. Proposal: auto-credit >1% delta; manual review 0.5%-1%. Will align wording with legal.

marisol: Good. Owners proposal: lina (ledger corrections & audit trail), kevin (ingest fix + deploy), samir (monitoring + SLO guardrails), eli (postmortem retro & process changes), maggie (customer messaging & credits). Approve?

eli: I can run the retrospective and produce a short action checklist for leader failover scenarios. ETA Fri.

kevin: Fix plan split: (a) hotfix to enforce idempotent aggregation (today), (b) leader-change safe checkpoints (next week), (c) e2e test for failover ordering (2 sprints). Hotfix ready for review.

lina: For corrections, I'll use the ledger_reconcile job. Dry-run SQL I used to surface diffs:

```sql
-- dry-run diff per account
SELECT account_id, SUM(billed_tokens) as billed, SUM(emitted_tokens) as emitted, (SUM(billed_tokens)-SUM(emitted_tokens)) AS delta
FROM token_ledger
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING ABS(delta) > 0;
```

lina: Corrections will be applied via ledger_reconcile --tag "recurrence-fix-2390001123" to keep audit chain. Will post sample accounts for canary before wider run.

kevin: Hotfix deploy commands (staging dry-run first):

```bash
# staging
./deploy.sh ingest --env staging --ref fix/idempotent-agg --dry-run
# when green
./deploy.sh ingest --env prod --ref fix/idempotent-agg --approve
```

ops-bot: deploybot: staging deploy started for service=ingest, run_id=deploy-20260324-11:02

kevin: Staging dry-run looks clean; no delta observed in the reprocess window. Planning prod deploy Tue AM if no issues.

samir: Alert rules added: token_drift_ratio > 0.5% for 60m, and aggregator-checkpoint-latency > 2s. PagerDuty routing set to on-call-ingest.

maggie: Customer note draft done. Will post to #cs and send to legal for sign-off. Template: apology, summary, credit amount, timeline of fix.

marisol: Action list (I'm copying to the remediation tracker):
- lina: produce invoice correction spreadsheet + 20-account canary sample (ETA EOD today)
- kevin: prod deploy of hotfix (ETA Tue AM) + runbook updates (ETA Wed)
- samir: monitoring + PD rules (done) + add SLO guardrail doc (ETA Mon)
- eli: retro doc + follow-up checklist (ETA Fri)
- maggie: customer comms + credit policy confirmation with legal (ETA Mon)

marisol: Also we should schedule a cross-team tabletop for failover scenarios. Who can join Fri 10am?

kevin: I can.

samir: I'll be there.

lina: Can do.

maggie: CS will join as well.

marisol: Great. If no other changes I'll convert these into tickets and assign owners. We'll reconvene after the prod deploy.

eli: One more note: suggest adding a small end-to-end synthetic that asserts ledger parity every hour. I'll add that to the retro items.

lina: Ack. Adding synthetic to corrections checklist.

ops-bot: deploybot: prod deploy scheduled for service=ingest, run_id=deploy-20260324-19:00
